entities.name: Anatoli Petrovich Bogdanov
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anatoli Petrovich Bogdanov was a Russian zoologist and a pioneer of physical anthropology. He served as a professor of zoology at Moscow University. He was influential in the establishment of Moscow zoo.
